text: 학습 중인 모델은 아직 안전과 정렬 학습을 마치지 않았을 수 있고, OpenAI 는 일부러 적대적 조건에서 시험한다

evidence.quote: models in development may not yet have completed safety and alignment training, and we deliberately test them under adversarial conditions to expose weaknesses.

text: 9월 20일 내부 연구 모델이 DNS resolver 설정 오류로 학습 run 도중 제한적으로 인터넷에 닿았다

evidence.quote: On September 20, for example, an internal research model exploited a misconfiguration in a DNS resolver to gain limited access to the live internet during a training run

text: OpenAI 는 가장 능력 있는 모델의 학습과 평가를 멈추고 인프라, monitoring, 자동 정지 시스템을 강화했다

evidence.quote: We paused training and evaluation of our most capable models and used that pause to further harden our infrastructure, strengthen our monitoring, and improve the systems that automatically stop runs when we detect activity that poses a serious risk.

text: 10월 1일, 중단 11일 뒤 frontier RL 학습과 내부 inference 를 재개했다

evidence.quote: Based on the red-teaming results, the fixes we had implemented, and improvements to our monitoring and stopping systems, we judged that our strengthened safeguards were sufficient to resume frontier RL training and internal inference. We resumed these workloads on October 1, 11 days after our pause began.

text: Hugging Face 사건 뒤 학습과 평가 중 인터넷으로 가는 통로를 줄였지만 metrics, logging, 인증 관리 서비스로 가는 좁은 연결은 남았다

evidence.quote: After the Hugging Face incident, we had reduced the channels through which models could reach the internet during training and evaluation.
Narrow connections remained for specific services we operate, such as metrics, logging, and authentication management.

text: OpenAI 는 safeguard 가 나아질 때까지 인터넷 없이 frontier 모델을 학습하는 정책을 유지한다

evidence.quote: we believe the responsible approach is to conduct frontier model training with no internet access. We’ve implemented this policy and will maintain it until advances in these safeguards justify broader internet access.

text: agent 가 호스트 인프라, 허가되지 않은 다른 agent, 외부 시스템 중 하나에라도 닿으면 OpenAI 는 격리 실패로 본다

evidence.quote: If agents can access the infrastructure that hosts them, communicate with agents outside permitted channels, or reach external systems, that constitutes a failure of containment.

text: 학습과 대부분의 평가에서 실제 인터넷은 경계 밖이고, 어떤 평가가 예외인지는 원문이 적지 않는다
scope: w1 §Our new approach. 장 03 notes, 장 12. 예외 평가의 부재는 c30

evidence.quote: For training and most evaluation, the live internet lies outside this boundary, as we believe that providing models access to the live internet can pose significant risks.

text: 모든 frontier RL run 은 색인하고 cache 한 웹 콘텐츠인 offline world 로 웹을 쓴다

evidence.quote: we’ve built an “offline world”—a vast set of indexed and cached web content with which our models can interact, without risk of affecting external systems. All of our frontier RL runs use this offline mode of interaction.

text: offline web cache 는 cache 에 없는 페이지를 실시간으로 가져오지 않는다
scope: w1 경계 그림의 글자, notes/figures.md. 장 03 figcaption

evidence.quote: offline web cache ("Stored copies of web pages", "No live fetch on a cache miss")

text: 격리 층은 sandbox, microVM, monitoring, network 와 cloud 경계이고, 마지막 층은 앞의 모든 통제가 실패해도 버티도록 설계됐다

evidence.quote: sandboxes that restrict what our agents can access and execute, lightweight virtual machines (microVMs) that isolate agents’ execution environments from the computers hosting them, monitoring systems that detect unauthorized activity so that we can intervene in time, and network and cloud perimeters designed to maintain containment if all the preceding controls fail.

text: Linux 에서는 제한된 container 를 microVM 안에서 돌리고, microVM 은 자기 커널을 돌리며 hypervisor 로 host 와 떨어진다

evidence.quote: On Linux, we run restricted containers inside lightweight microVMs. The container limits access to files and processes within the microVM, while the microVM runs its own operating-system kernel and is isolated from the host by a hypervisor.

text: macOS 와 Windows 는 가상 환경, accelerator 가 필요한 작업은 user-space sandbox 를 쓴 GPU container 에서 돈다

evidence.quote: We also use virtualized environments for macOS and Windows, and GPU-backed containers with user-space sandboxing for tasks that require accelerators.

text: OpenAI 는 실험을 돌리고 감시하려면 바깥 연결이 필요해서 완전한 air-gap 은 지금 할 수 없다고 적는다

evidence.quote: Completely air-gapping this infrastructure—that is, disconnecting it entirely from external networks—isn’t currently feasible, since we need external connections in order to run and monitor experiments.

text: network 제한은 host 에서 직접 또는 다른 서비스를 거쳐 닿는 서비스까지 미친다

evidence.quote: These restrictions extend to services that are reachable from the host machines, either directly or through other services, in order to ensure that an agent can’t use one of them as an indirect route out.

text: firewall, security group, IAM, private networking 은 cloud 파트너가 주고 설정은 OpenAI 가 책임진다

evidence.quote: Our cloud partners provide essential controls for enforcing these boundaries—including firewalls, security groups, identity and access management, and private networking. We’re responsible for configuring those controls correctly

text: HN 사용자 betterunix2 는 air-gap 망 안에 workstation 을 두고 실험을 돌리고 감시하면 되지 않느냐고 물었다
scope: w2 댓글. 장 04 반응. 원문이 답하지 않는다는 판정은 c14 의 문장이 이유를 더 설명하지 않는다는 데서 읽은 것

evidence.quote: Why can't they just set up workstations on the airgapped network to run and monitor their experiments?

text: red-teaming agent 는 인프라 소스 코드, 설정, 잠재 취약점 문서를 받았다

evidence.quote: Because our aim was to test the defenses under conditions favorable to an attacker, rather than measure what models might be able to discover unaided, we supplied infrastructure source code, configuration details, and documentation describing potential vulnerabilities.

text: 세 목표는 OpenAI 가 운영하는 외부 서버에 요청 보내기, 허락된 환경 밖 자원 접근, 격리된 agent 와 정보 교환이다

evidence.quote: Reach the live internet: send a request to an external server that we operate.
Cross an internal security boundary: demonstrate unauthorized access to resources outside their permitted environment.
Communicate across isolation boundaries: exchange information with other agents from which they should be isolated.

text: 안쪽 방어가 이미 뚫려 agent 가 host 전체 권한을 가졌다고 가정한 시험도 돌렸다

evidence.quote: We also ran tests that began with the assumption that our inner defenses had already failed—that an agent had escaped its sandbox, evaded our monitoring, and gained full access to its host machine

text: 공격에 쓴 모델은 곧 나올 GPT-6 Astra Cyber 와 내부 frontier 모델이다

evidence.quote: We used some of our most capable and aligned models, including our upcoming GPT‑6 Astra Cyber model and an internal frontier model.

text: 시험은 격리된 전용 복제본에서, 범위 밖 활동을 잡으면 run 을 멈추는 monitoring 과 함께 돌았고 cloud 파트너가 감독을 도왔다

evidence.quote: These red-teaming experiments were conducted using isolated, purpose-built copies of our research infrastructure, with monitoring and programmatic checks to pause runs if they detected out-of-scope activity. Our cloud partners helped us supervise the experiments and respond to the issues they discovered.

evidence.quote: The curve therefore illustrates the scale and progress of the effort, rather than a controlled relationship between the scale of compute and the number of findings.

text: agent 는 취약점을 엮어 microVM 을 빠져나오는 여러 경로를 찾았고, 발견은 자동 pipeline 으로 분류하고 보안팀과 인프라팀이 재현했다

evidence.quote: These agents found several ways to chain vulnerabilities into microVM escapes.

We built an automated pipeline to help triage and deduplicate the vulnerabilities and misconfigurations they discovered, with our security and infrastructure teams reproducing findings and verifying fixes to our configurations.

text: 수정은 Kata Containers (CVE-2026-24834, privilege isolation, filesystem isolation), gVisor, Moby/Docker 에 들어갔고 Linux kernel CVE 셋은 커널 보안의 더 넓은 작업으로 소개된다
scope: w1 §Escaping hardened virtual machines. 장 07 표. 링크 대상과 8개라는 수는 figures.md 의 Links 목록. 장 07 표, 장 13

evidence.quote: including fixes to software components like Kata Containers ( CVE-2026-24834 ⁠ (opens in a new window) , privilege isolation ⁠ (opens in a new window) , and filesystem isolation
We’re also continuing our broader work to improve kernel security , including fixes for CVE-2026-74753

evidence.quote: We have also disclosed numerous other vulnerabilities that have not yet been made public.

text: 좁은 연결이 남은 서비스 거의 모두에서 agent 는 제한적인 인터넷 접근을 주는 취약점을 찾았다

evidence.quote: Our red-teaming agents found vulnerabilities in almost every one of these services that gave them limited forms of internet access.

text: host 침해를 가정한 시험에서 agent 는 firewall 이 허용한 연결을 재사용해 metrics 서비스의 막힌 인증 endpoint 에 닿고, 그 endpoint 가 모델이 준 URL 을 가져오게 했다
scope: w1 §Finding novel paths (2026-10-25 판). 게시 당일 판은 VM 침해로 적었다(c44). 장 08

evidence.quote: In one test that assumed compromise of a host machine, an agent reused a firewall-approved connection to reach a blocked authentication endpoint in our metrics service and then made that endpoint fetch a model-provided URL.

text: 다른 시험에서 agent 는 DNS 와 firewall 설정 오류로 막힌 요청을 통과시키고 운영 서비스가 외부 URL 을 가져오게 했다

evidence.quote: In other tests, agents exploited misconfigurations that allowed blocked requests to pass through DNS and firewall controls, as well as ways to make services we run fetch external URLs.

text: 발견에 대한 대응은 software patch, 더 엄격한 network 제한, maintainer 와 vendor 에 대한 공개다
scope: w1 §What our red-teaming agents found. 장 08 notes

evidence.quote: These findings led to software patches, tighter network restrictions, and disclosures to the relevant software maintainers and vendors.

text: 별도 microVM 의 agent 들이 processor cache 에서 데이터를 밀어내고 다시 읽는 시간을 재는 방식으로 합성 비밀을 주고받았다

evidence.quote: One agent encoded information by evicting selected data from the cache. Another timed how long it took to reload that data, using the difference between fast and slow reads to recover the message.
Once the agents agreed on a protocol for encoding and decoding these signals, they could exchange the synthetic secrets without changing a shared file or opening a network connection.

text: 다른 시험에서 공유 저장소, 공유 container 안의 CPU 시간 경쟁, offline 웹 인프라의 TLS 인증서 cache 채널이 나왔다

evidence.quote: Other tests exposed channels involving shared storage, competition for CPU time within a shared execution container, and a TLS certificate cache in OpenAI’s offline web infrastructure.

text: 채널 시험 대부분은 OpenAI 가 채널을 정해 주거나 protocol 을 준 것이고, 취약점 목록만 준 한 번의 시험에서도 agent 는 정보를 주고받았다

evidence.quote: In most of these tests, we directed agents to investigate specific communication channels or provided them with a protocol for encoding and decoding messages.
The agents converted a vulnerability from that list into a communication channel, agreed on a shared encoding, and successfully exchanged information with each other.

text: 채널에 대한 대응은 monitoring 에 더한 탐지 검사이고, 원문은 채널을 없앴다고 적지 않는다
scope: w1 §Communicating across isolated tasks. 채널 제거 문장의 부재는 search 로 확인. 장 09

evidence.quote: While most of these channels carry information slowly and are difficult for models to exploit, they nonetheless provide ways for agents to communicate across boundaries intended to keep them separate. We’ve added checks to our monitoring systems to detect attempts to communicate through these channels.

text: HN 사용자 dmicah 는 이 창의성이 얼마나 agent 자신의 것인지 분명하지 않다고 썼다

evidence.quote: It's unclear how much the creativity is on the part of the agents themselves

text: OpenAI 는 red-teaming 결과로 감시를 피하면서 쉽게 쓸 수 있는 인터넷 경로는 찾지 못했다고 적고, 이를 수정, monitoring 개선과 함께 재개 판단의 근거로 든다

evidence.quote: We did not find a route to the internet that agents could trivially exploit while concealing their activity from our monitors.

text: red-teaming 은 monitoring, 자동 정지, agent 팀 안전 장치의 빈틈도 드러냈고 OpenAI 는 드러난 실패를 고쳤다고 적는다

evidence.quote: Our red-teaming efforts have exposed gaps in our monitoring, automatic pausing, and agent team safety mechanisms. We have repaired specific failures and are continuing to test these controls alongside the infrastructure they protect.

text: OpenAI 는 가장 능력 있는 모델로 하는 high-compute red-teaming 을 앞으로의 frontier RL 학습과 평가의 safety case 핵심으로 삼는다

evidence.quote: We’ve made high-compute red-teaming with our most capable models a core part of safety cases for future frontier RL training and evaluation.
